name: com.streethawk.library.PushNotificationBroadcastReceiver
description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk sends this receiver push-message and notification-response events. It displays campaign prompts, opens configured links or app actions, and records whether a prompt was accepted, declined, or postponed.
disableEffect: StreetHawk campaign notifications, their actions, and response tracking will stop.
